author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೀಳಲ್ಲ ನಿನಕೆಲಸ ಪರಹಿತವೆ ಗುರಿಯಾಗೆ
ಮೇಲಲ್ಲ ತತ್ವಗಳು ರಾಗದ್ವೇಷಗಳಿರಲು
ಬಾಳುಮೆಗೆ ಬೇಕಿಹುದು ಸಹಕಾರ ಸಹನೆಗಳು
ಸೀಳಿನಡೆ ತ್ವೇಷಗಳ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: No work of yours is lowly if others’ good is its aim;
no principle stands high while attachment and hatred remain;
what a life needs is cooperation and patience —
so cut your way through anger and spite, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: No work is small if it is done for the good of others, and no principle is lofty if it is held with attachment and hatred. A shared life needs cooperation and patience. Make your way past anger and ill will.
